author: Ben Janca
description: We sat down with Diablo 5's Production Director, Tiffany Wat, and EP, Matt Zitterman, to talk about the game, why it was announced now, and how its scope was too grand to be a simple expansion to Diablo 4.
title: Devs Explain Why Diablo 5 Needed to be a New Game Instead Of An Expansion For 4

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Microsoft has released a statement in response to a new rumor that claims the company is considering a massive shakeup to Xbox Game Pass in 2027 that would include numerous significant changes.

ResetEra user Slayven, who has accurately reported on unannounced Xbox news before, said the changes could include the bifurcation of Game Pass into two tiers: one with ads and one without. The tier with ads would be $13/month, while Game Pass without ads would
title: Microsoft Reacts To Xbox Game Pass Rumor That Could Change The Service In A Big Way

author: Ben Janca
description: We chat with Overwatch's game director Aaron Keller and associate game director Alec Dawson about the game's 10 year anniversary, its latest hero Doctrine, and we learn that Tracer used to have laser eyes?
title: Overwatch – 10 Years Of Overwatch | Blizzcon 2026 Interview

author: Gabe Gurwin
description:
Last month, System 3 Software released a trailer for James Pond Legacy, a four-game collection for Nintendo Switch 2. But the gameplay footage was largely overshadowed by accusations its developer used generative AI to create the game's promotional artwork and cover. System 3 followed this trailer up with a blog post asserting that generative AI was not used in the development process for James Pond Legacy, but some wires were evidently crossed. 

If you go back and watch that trailer, it's not difficult to see why viewers pointed out the AI-like quality of the 3D characte
title: James Pond Legacy Situation Is More Than Meets The AI

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
HBO boss Casey Bloys has once again said that the upcoming third season of The Last of Us is expected to be its last.

He told Deadline that Season 3 is coming in 2027, though did not confirm when in the year. Asked if he still think it's the final season, Bloys said he believes showrunner Craig Mazin "has planned it as the final season."

In January this year, Bloys was asked if Season 3 is going to be the last, and he said,
title: The Last Of Us Season 3 Is Probably The Final Season, HBO Says Yet Again

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Following the GTA 6 Extended Look, songs from the GTA 6 soundtrack have started to be compiled into playlists thanks to the mammoth 25-minute trailer's heap of new confirmed tracks. There are a host of great tracks that I can't stop humming, so what better way to enjoy them than a curated playlist that you can stick on repeat to learn every word ahead of the game's release?

There are electronica-laden retro hits that suit the Vice City vibes of Leonida through to modern rock tracks that'll have you singing their catchy hooks as you cruise the streets. Below is the full list of GTA 6 soundtrack titles from the Extended Look and all of the trailers so far.
title: GTA 6 Soundtrack – All Confirmed Songs So Far

author: Callum Self
description:
Sometimes, I simply enjoy reeling people into playing a delightful indie, and Dredge… well, Dredge is one of those times. It’s a fishing game, yes, but it’s one that hides a Lovecraftian selection of horrors beneath the surface of what, at first, seems fairly tame. If you’re not quite ready for the sheer panic of the best horror games but still want something with spooky vibes, Dredge is what you’re looking for, and right now, it’s cheaper than ever.

As someone who doesn’t like the idea of fishing, it surprised me that Dredge ended up becoming one of my favorite indie games. That’s helped by the fact that it’s not really about fishing, at least not in the traditional sense. Instead, it’s about making your boat better w
title: Dredge Has Never Been Cheaper, So Grab This Lovecraftian Fishing Adventure At An All-Time Low

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Microsoft has announced the second wave of removals from Xbox Game Pass this month, and eight more games are heading out soon.

Earlier this month, Microsoft removed 10 games from Game Pass, so a total of 18 games are being removed this month alone.

Titles set for removal on September 30 include Atomfall, Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light, Sifu, and Little Nightmares 2 Enhanced Edition. Other games getting dumped include SOPA Tale of the Stolen Potato, Sworn, Little Rocket Lab, and Terminull Brigade.

In terms of
title: Xbox Game Pass Removes 8 More Games Very Soon

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The second wave of games coming to Xbox Game Pass in September has been revealed, and we've also gotten a sneak peek at what's coming in early October. In total, there'll be 12 games headed to Xbox and PC Game Pass libraries, joining September's wave of new arrivals. A few games are also leaving Game Pass on September 30, so you only have a few more weeks to check out some gems like Atomfall and Sifu.

Here's a closer look at what you can download soon.

Several day-one games are launching this month, and Game Pass subscribers can check them out, starting with Kernel Hearts on September 17. This magical adventure should scratch several genre itches, as it's billed as an action RPG with roguelike elements and optional multiplayer co-op.
title: Xbox Game Pass Gets 12 More Games In September

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
It appears some GTA 6 news is coming up soon, and it could be focused on the game's music. A variety of musicians have released GTA-inspired teasers, and people are theorizing it's tied to some kind of music reveal for the game.

Country pop singer Morgan Wallen released an image showing GTA-inspired visuals of a pool with no water in it. Rapper Travis Scott, meanwhile, shared his own GTA-inspired image of high heels on a pole. He wrote, "See yall soon," and tagged Rockstar Games in his post. Before this, fans thought they
title: Big GTA 6 News Could Be Coming Up Soon

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
A fresh batch of games are coming to the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog for Extra- and Premium-tier subscribers, but several games are also on their way out. While we don't have an exact date for their exit just yet, there'll be seven games in total leaving soon, so you only have a few weeks left to play one of the best survival-horrors of all time and a melodramatic gangland adventure where you can hit people really hard on the head with a baseball bat.

PlayStation Plus Game Catalog games leaving soon
title: PlayStation Plus Is Removing 7 Games Soon, So Play Them While You Can

author: Callum Self
description:
There’s never been a better time to be a fan of extraction shooters, with the subgenre of the best FPS games wrapping even the most experienced players in tense, challenging situations. Even with Marathon and Hunt: Showdown giving FPS players a tough time, Escape From Tarkov makes them look almost childishly easy. This is one of the toughest games I’ve ever played, which is why, at its lowest price, it’s the perfect time to give it a try.

While Marathon remains a personal favorite of mine, Escape From Tarkov knocks the experience up to eleven. Every step in those fateful raids could be a misstep into death, and like any entry in the subgenre, that means going back to square one. All that gear, the hard-earned stuff you took into the raid, is go
title: Brutally Hard And Tense FPS Escape From Tarkov Is Cheaper Than Ever Right Now

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Actor Stephen Root recently confirmed that he will appear in GTA 6, after people correctly identified him as the voice of the drug-runner Brian Heder. He confirmed this on September 13, and on September 14, Root won his first-ever Emmy award for his incredible performance on the show Widow's Bay.

In winning an Emmy, Root becomes just the second-ever Emmy-winning actor to appear in a GTA game. The first? That was James Woods, who voiced
title: GTA 6’s Stephen Root Is The Franchise’s Second-Ever Emmy Winning Actor

author: Chris Compendio
description:
For the longest time in the Kingdom Hearts series, Kairi has gotten the short end of the stick, but the franchise's upcoming crossover with Fortnite will finally let Kairi fans choose violence.

A new trailer for Fortnite's ongoing Chapter 7 Season 4 shows the trio of Sora, Riku, and Kairi in action. The three sport their Kingdom Hearts 2 appearances, and each wields their own Keyblade. They're seen fighting Heartless (or Heartless-like?) enemies in an area resembling their home world of Destiny Islands, hinting that the ever-evolving Fortnite map will add the locale.

It's all set to the Kingdom Hearts 2 theme "Sanctuary" by Utada Hikaru, which still slaps two decades later. There's no footage of the Destiny Islands trio wielding firearms, but Sora using a shotgun and Kairi blasting opponents wit
title: Kingdom Hearts’ Kairi Has Suffered Enough, Will Now Headshot You In Fortnite

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Between the release of Final Fantasy 7 in 1997 and the first chapter in the Remake trilogy in 2020, quite a few games have been released and have gone on to inspire developers. Final Fantasy 7 Revelation game director Naoki Hamaguchi is one such developer, as he explained that games like The Witcher 3 and Horizon helped inspire him and his team to deliver cinematic storytelling native to interactive media, as well as player agency through customizability and scalable world exploration.

"Final Fantasy 6 was a very impactful title for me when I was playing the games when I was younger, when I was a child. But as a creator, I would say that The Witcher 3 would fill that role of what inspired game creation," Hamaguchi said to GameSpot. "When I started working on the Remake series, I would frequently go back
title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation’s Director Kept Coming Back To The Witcher 3 For Inspiration

author: Callum Self
description:
I love The Blood of Dawnwalker. As someone who usually finds themselves sticking to the storyline and just driving through the main plot, I’ve found myself losing track of time (ironically) in the blood-drinking shoes of Coen. Vampires are awesome, and The Blood of Dawnwalker delivers these creatures of the night in a tantalizing RPG that, if anything, has changed my perspective on the genre. So, when an opportunity to get it for less than a cup of coffee comes along, you can bet your staking butt that I’m going to recommend it. Well, that opportunity has come up.

Before I get into the deal aspect, let me sell you on why The Blood of Dawnwalker is a contender for my best RPGs list. It brings the vibe and world of The Witcher, pairs it with a vampiric twist, and makes the combat much
title: You Could Get The Blood Of Dawnwalker For Less Than The Price Of A Coffee With This Mystery Crate

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Developer IO has confirmed that 007 First Light's Switch 2 edition has been delayed for a second time. It's now scheduled for March 2027.

The studio said in a notice that First Light's Switch 2 version was delayed "to ensure we deliver the quality of experience players expect."

"This additional time will go toward polishing the Nintendo Switch 2 performance of the game," IO said.

First Light's Switch 2 version was playable at Gamescom recently, and IO said it was "thrilled by the positive feedback." The same demo will be at Tokyo Game Show this week in Japan.

"Thank you for your patience, understanding, and continued support," IO said.
title: 007 First Light’s Switch 2 Edition Delayed Yet Again, Here’s How Long You Have To Wait

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Final Fantasy 7 Revelation is aiming to end the remake trilogy with a bang, and alongside the main campaign, there'll be plenty of other activities to tackle when you're not racing to stop Sephiroth from destroying the planet. Snowboarding is one such distraction, as the iconic minigame from the original Final Fantasy 7 is back, and Square Enix is suggesting that something wild could take place in it.

An activity that can be accessed at the Golden Saucer, game director Naoki Hamaguchi hasn't gone into too many details about it just yet, but he did tease that Square Enix knows that there are a lot of "high expectations" surrounding it. Especially when Red XIII (Nanaki) takes part in that event.
title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Brings Back Snowboarding, And Red XIII Might Steal The Show Again

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Diablo's world of Sanctuary isn't a top tourist destination, thanks to roaming monsters and demonic forces looking to corrupt humanity, and in Diablo 5, everything has gone to hell--quite literally! Unlike the previous games in the series, which revolved around saving Sanctuary from Diablo and his Prime Evil Kin, Diablo 5 kicks off long after the Lord of Terror has conquered the land. In a world this bleak, how will players find the motivation to keep going when evil has already triumphed?

Speaking to GameSpot at BlizzCon, the Diablo team discussed the grim setting of Diablo 5, as well as the glimmers of hope that still exist even during Diablo's post-apocalyptic r
title: Diablo 5 Doubles Down On The Darkness, But Hope Still Has A Place In Sanctuary

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
World of Warcraft has plenty of classes for players to choose from, but according to the game's senior game designer, Josh Greenfield, there's one class that has earned a very specific reputation.

Speaking to GameSpot at BlizzCon, Greenfield and senior art director Jeff Parrott discussed their favorite and most-played classes. While Parrott confirmed that his is Hunter, Greenfield's infamous inclination toward the Paladin was discussed a little more in depth.
title: WoW Devs Confirm Paladins Are A “Dad Class”

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
At this year's BlizzCon, Blizzard announced a new version of World of Warcraft Classic, called World of Warcraft Forever. Blizzard says WoW Forever is "built as a new permanent home alongside modern and Classic WoW." It's set after the events of Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom but before Molten Core, and sends players back to the original continents with a cap at level 60. There are new stories, a new class, and over 1,000 new quests in the title.

With World of Warcraft Forever launching on November 4, a beta is due to start this week. There are a few ways you can gain access, so here's all you need to know.
title: The WoW Forever Beta Starts This Week, Here’s How To Get Access

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
One of the most satisfying things about the Diablo games is their loot grind, and in Diablo 5, Blizzard has plans to keep you clicking enemies to death for a long time in pursuit of an elusive piece of armor or weapon. While it's still early days in terms of how itemization will be handled in the game, Blizzard has confirmed that gear-based sets will return. Set items were originally absent from Diablo 4 when the game launched in 2023, although set bonuses were later added through the Talisman system. Instead of armor collections, players could equip passive bonuses, set effects, and unique powers without needing to replace their current gear.

"Something we talk about a lot on the team is we want Diablo 5 to be a game that feels like it has elements for you, regardless of which Diablo game was your favorite," execu
title: Diablo 5 Is Bringing Back Set Items, But Wants To Avoid Their Biggest Problem

description:
If you've ever wondered which Overwatch heroes the people actually making the game enjoy playing, the answer is surprisingly varied. At BlizzCon 2026, GameSpot spoke with Overwatch game director Aaron Keller and associate game director Alec Dawson about their personal favorites, their original mains, and the newer heroes they think you should be playing.

Here are the best Overwatch heroes according to Blizzard developers:
title: The Best Overwatch Heroes, According To Blizzard
